exposure: Total number of neonates on the same ward
Number of known neonatal ESBL-E carriers on the same ward
outcome: Prevalence of ESBL-E carriage at admission
Incidence of ESBL-E acquisition during hospital stay
cohort: 569 neonates admitted to Kilifi County Hospital from July 2013 through August 2014
finding: Carriage of ESBL-E was common among neonates on admission, and in-hospital acquisition was rapid, with the dissemination and selection of ESBL-E appearing to be driven by hospital exposures, operative delivery, and neonatal ward patient density.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was a significant risk factor for ESBL-E carriage at admission.
